message.content: Starting the hunt — probing for controller limit violations.
Found an overflow on the first probe — now shrinking it to the minimal case.
Ledger: open – spill clamp fails when net inflow exceeds max outflow; ruled out – none yet. Replaying the shrunk failure to confirm it.
Confirmed it replays — inspecting the violation step and buildup.
Violation level 40.58 over capacity 40 with spill still zero. Checking earlier steps to trace the buildup.
Level was already 38.58 just before overflowing. Looking further back to ground the report.
Ledger: open – why spill stays 0 despite overfill; ruled out – none. Gathering pre-violation states for evidence.
Ledger open: net inflow (8 mean) overwhelms max outflow (1 demand +6 valve) so tank must overfill; ruled out: none yet. Intervention to test: lower inflow to remove overload.
Counterfactual passes with only inflow lowered — assembling the final violation report.
